driver_cards.label: Natural Gas Price
driver_cards.interpretation: Model anchor = latest completed weekly ISO close from canonical daily history. Market comparison uses the live OANDA snapshot when fresh; otherwise comparison is marked stale and deviation is not trusted.

driver_cards.label: US Dollar (Broad)
driver_cards.interpretation: A firm dollar typically pressures energy commodities. Broad USD index at 120.71.
driver_cards.valuation_badge: EXPERIMENTAL DRIVER — NOT INCLUDED IN FAIR VALUE

driver_cards.label: Working Gas Storage
driver_cards.interpretation: Storage is 173 Bcf above the 5-year same-week average (2911 Bcf), 5.9% surplus.

driver_cards.label: US Dry Gas Production — YoY Change
driver_cards.interpretation: Faster year-over-year production growth increases available supply and lowers modeled fair value.
driver_cards.valuation_note: Included in fair value as production_yoy_pct

driver_cards.label: LNG Exports
driver_cards.concept: U.S. liquefied natural gas exports (not feedgas)
driver_cards.interpretation: Strong LNG exports are typically supportive for domestic prices (export volumes — not terminal feedgas).
driver_cards.valuation_badge: EXPERIMENTAL DRIVER — NOT INCLUDED IN FAIR VALUE

driver_cards.label: Heating Degree Days
driver_cards.interpretation: Heating Degree Days: actual=0.0, week-of-year normal=0.0, anomaly=+0.00σ vs same-week climatology. Current HDD of 0 is a genuine midsummer observation (no heating demand), not missing data.
driver_cards.valuation_badge: EXPERIMENTAL DRIVER — NOT INCLUDED IN FAIR VALUE

driver_cards.label: Cooling Degree Days
driver_cards.interpretation: Cooling Degree Days: actual=25.0, week-of-year normal=79.6, anomaly=-5.91σ vs same-week climatology.
driver_cards.valuation_badge: EXPERIMENTAL DRIVER — NOT INCLUDED IN FAIR VALUE

driver_cards.label: Seasonality
driver_cards.interpretation: Informational only — not a validated Natural Gas seasonality valuation model. Historical Jul seasonality: avg weekly return -2.47% across 8 sample weeks in price history.
driver_cards.valuation_badge: INFORMATIONAL ONLY — NOT INCLUDED IN FAIR VALUE

contribution_breakdown.identity: log(fair) = intercept + Σ (βᵢ · xᵢ); fair = exp(log(fair))
contribution_breakdown.note: price_impact_pct = 100*(exp(log_contribution)-1) is the multiplicative price-space effect of that driver term alone.
